data.name: Earthcare
data.description: Earthcare LLC is a US-based biochar producer that deploys patented gasification systems to convert high-ash organic waste streams — including biosolids, manure, food waste, and MSW digestate — into biochar ("Ecochar"). Projects are certified under Puro.earth and the company sells carbon removal credits alongside the biochar product. As of mid-2025 the company had 12 operational gasifiers with a 13th coming online at Minnich Eggs.
